production-cohort-driver.rb.source:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "json"
require "digest"
require "fileutils"
require "open3"
harness, runtime_root, app, seed, output, gate_path, worker = ARGV.map { File.expand_path(_1) }
require File.join(harness, "bench/pass")
require File.join(harness, "fixtures/corpus/blog_show_get_only")
revision = "ae025b0d9f456d9f9bef55e9e131bc25178e83cb"
raise "new cohort output required; no retries" if File.exist?(output)
raise "two allocated slots and interpreter required" unless ENV["BENCH_JOBS"] == "2" && JitStability.mode == "interpreter"
raise "heap floors changed" unless HeapWindows.floors == [1_000_000, 250_000, 100_000, 20_000, 10_000]
check_git = ->(root) {
  sha, status = Open3.capture2("/usr/bin/git", "-C", root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
  changes, clean_status = Open3.capture2("/usr/bin/git", "-C", root, "status", "--porcelain")
  raise "unclean or wrong source revision" unless status.success? && clean_status.success? && sha.strip == revision && changes.empty?
}
check_git.call(harness)
check_git.call(runtime_root)
gate = JSON.parse(File.read(gate_path))
raise "published production gate required" unless gate.fetch("status") == "pass" && gate.dig("provenance", "revision") == revision &&
  gate.fetch("cold").fetch("companions").size == 2 && gate.fetch("cold").fetch("companions").all? {
    _1.fetch("status") == "equivalent_for_executed_scenarios" && _1.fetch("cold_equal") && _1.fetch("forbidden_chains_absent") } &&
  gate.fetch("pairs").keys.sort == %w[none render_subscriber] && gate.fetch("pairs").values.all? { _1.fetch("pairs") == 192 }
published = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(harness, "docs/passes/sealed-production-results.json")))
raise "runtime/harness pins changed" unless PassBench.runtime_fingerprint(File.join(runtime_root, "gem/lib")) == published.fetch("runtime_files_sha256") &&
  PassBench.harness_fingerprint == published.fetch("harness_files_sha256") && gate.fetch("runtime_files_sha256") == published.fetch("runtime_files_sha256") &&
  gate.fetch("harness_files_sha256") == published.fetch("harness_files_sha256")
pin = ->(file) { Digest::SHA256.file(file).hexdigest }
manifest_path = File.join(app, ".lowrail/manifest.json")
raise "artifact or fixture changed" unless pin.call(manifest_path) == published.fetch("manifest_sha256") &&
  pin.call(File.join(harness, "fixtures/corpus/blog_show_get_only.rb")) == published.fetch("fixture").fetch("sha256")
manifest = JSON.parse(File.read(manifest_path))
raise "only real production units" unless manifest.fetch("units").map { _1.fetch("pass") } ==
  %w[sealed/form_scaffold sealed/token_tag sealed/collection_render] && manifest.fetch("files").empty? && manifest.fetch("templates", {}).empty?
tool_root = "/tmp/lowrail-sealed-valgrind-brk512"
tool = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(tool_root, "share/lowrail/valgrind.json")))
raise "wrong brk512 tool" unless tool == published.dig("counter_prerequisite", "pinned_brk512_counter", "tool") &&
  pin.call(File.join(tool_root, tool.fetch("tool"))) == tool.fetch("tool_sha256")
BlogShowGetOnly.validate(seed)
files = {File.expand_path(__FILE__) => pin.call(__FILE__), worker => pin.call(worker), manifest_path => pin.call(manifest_path),
  gate_path => pin.call(gate_path), RbConfig.ruby => pin.call(RbConfig.ruby),
  File.join(tool_root, tool.fetch("tool")) => tool.fetch("tool_sha256")}
published.fetch("runtime_files_sha256").each { |file, sha| files[File.join(runtime_root, "gem/lib", file)] = sha }
published.fetch("harness_files_sha256").each { |file, sha| files[File.join(harness, "bench", file)] = sha }
gate.fetch("native").fetch("native_binary").each { |file, sha| files[file] = sha }
manifest.fetch("units").each do |unit|
  unit.fetch("data").fetch("sources").each { |file, sha| files[File.expand_path(file, app)] = sha }
end
gem_roots = files.keys.filter_map { _1[%r{\A(.*/gems/(?:actionview|actionpack|activemodel|activerecord|activesupport|i18n)-[^/]+)/lib/}, 1] }.uniq
gem_roots.each { |root| Dir[File.join(root, "lib/**/*.rb")].each { files[_1] = pin.call(_1) } }
Dir[File.join(app, "{app,config,db,lib}/**/*")].select { File.file?(_1) }.each { files[_1] = pin.call(_1) }
files.each { |file, sha| raise "source mismatch: #{file}" unless pin.call(file) == sha }
Dir.chdir(app) { PassBench.preflight(File.join(app, ".lowrail"), File.join(runtime_root, "gem/lib"), root: app) }
FileUtils.rm_rf(File.join(app, "storage"))
FileUtils.cp_r(seed, File.join(app, "storage"))
FileUtils.rm_rf(File.join(app, "tmp"))
FileUtils.mkdir_p(output, mode: 0o700)
pins = {revision: revision, harness_root: harness, runtime_root: runtime_root,
  harness_map_sha256: published.fetch("pins").fetch("harness_map_sha256"),
  files_sha256: files, gate_report_sha256: pin.call(gate_path), manifest_sha256: pin.call(manifest_path),
  fixture: published.fetch("fixture"), tool: tool, scope: "One authorized production cohort, no pricing adapter or older-fixture comparison"}
pins_path = File.join(output, "pins.json")
File.write(pins_path, JSON.pretty_generate(pins))
File.chmod(0o444, pins_path)
env = ENV.keys.grep(/\A(?:LOWRAIL_|RUBY_|BUNDLE_|DATABASE_URL\z|RAILS_|RACK_ENV\z|BENCH_)/).to_h { [_1, nil] }.merge(
  "RAILS_ENV" => "production", "RACK_ENV" => "production", "SECRET_KEY_BASE_DUMMY" => "1", "SECRET_KEY_BASE" => nil,
  "LOWRAIL_SEALED" => "1", "LOWRAIL_ROOT" => app, "LOWRAIL_DIR" => File.join(app, ".lowrail"),
  "RUBYOPT" => "-I#{File.join(runtime_root, 'gem/lib')} -rlowrail/setup", "BENCH_JIT" => "0", "BENCH_WARMUP" => "50",
  "PRODUCTION_COHORT_PINS" => pins_path, "PRODUCTION_COHORT_PINS_SHA256" => pin.call(pins_path))
arms = %w[off_a off_b production].to_h { [_1, env.merge("LOWRAIL" => _1 == "production" ? "1" : "0")] }
metadata = {seed: 41231, rounds: 6, workers: {}, revision: revision, pins_sha256: pin.call(pins_path),
  harness_map_sha256: pins.fetch(:harness_map_sha256), gate_report_sha256: pin.call(gate_path),
  manifest_sha256: pin.call(manifest_path), fixture: published.fetch("fixture"), allocated_slots: [1, 2]}
accepted = RequestPairs.heap_instructions(arms, app, output, "GET:/articles/1", metadata, worker: worker, requests: 50)
samples_path = File.join(output, "samples.json")
samples = JSON.parse(File.read(samples_path))
raise "finite worker/round count changed" unless samples.fetch("workers").size == 18 && samples.fetch("samples").size == 6
samples.fetch("workers").each do |label, record|
  lines = File.readlines(File.join(output, "#{label}.log"))
  before = JSON.parse(lines.find { _1.start_with?("PRODUCTION_COHORT_PIN ") }.delete_prefix("PRODUCTION_COHORT_PIN "))
  after = JSON.parse(lines.find { _1.start_with?("PRODUCTION_COHORT_FINAL ") }.delete_prefix("PRODUCTION_COHORT_FINAL "))
  raise "worker pin mismatch" unless before.fetch("revision") == revision && after.fetch("revision") == revision &&
    before.fetch("pins_sha256") == pin.call(pins_path) && after.fetch("pins_sha256") == pin.call(pins_path)
  record["source_certificate"] = {"before" => before, "after" => after}
end
File.write(samples_path, JSON.pretty_generate(samples))
files.each { |file, sha| raise "source changed during cohort: #{file}" unless pin.call(file) == sha }
check_git.call(harness)
check_git.call(runtime_root)
BlogShowGetOnly.validate(File.join(app, "storage"))
File.write(File.join(output, "result.json"), JSON.pretty_generate(accepted: accepted, revision: revision,
  pins_sha256: pin.call(pins_path), samples_sha256: pin.call(samples_path), summary_sha256: pin.call(File.join(output, "summary.json")),
  workers: 18, rounds: 6, retry: false, excluded: [], slots_released: [1, 2]))
puts "PRODUCTION_COHORT #{accepted ? 'accepted' : 'REJECTED; retained'}"
exit(accepted ? 0 : 2)

# frozen_string_literal: true

# Symmetric, untimed provenance only. The pinned shared worker owns all work,
# warming, counter endpoints, heap gates and placement observations.
require "json"
require "digest"
require "open3"
pins_path = ENV.fetch("PRODUCTION_COHORT_PINS")
pins_sha = Digest::SHA256.file(pins_path).hexdigest
raise "cohort pins changed" unless pins_sha == ENV.fetch("PRODUCTION_COHORT_PINS_SHA256")
pins = JSON.parse(File.read(pins_path))
check = -> {
  revision, status = Open3.capture2("/usr/bin/git", "-C", pins.fetch("harness_root"), "rev-parse", "HEAD")
  clean, clean_status = Open3.capture2("/usr/bin/git", "-C", pins.fetch("harness_root"), "status", "--porcelain")
  raise "detached harness revision/cleanliness changed" unless status.success? && clean_status.success? &&
    revision.strip == pins.fetch("revision") && clean.empty?
  pins.fetch("files_sha256").each do |file, expected|
    raise "source changed: #{file}" unless Digest::SHA256.file(file).hexdigest == expected
  end
  {revision: revision.strip, harness_clean: true, harness_map_sha256: pins.fetch("harness_map_sha256"),
    pins_sha256: pins_sha, worker_sha256: Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest, pid: Process.pid,
    ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION}
}
puts "PRODUCTION_COHORT_PIN #{JSON.generate(check.call)}"
$stdout.flush
load File.join(pins.fetch("harness_root"), "bench/heap_requests.rb")
runtimes = %w[Lowrail::FormScaffold Lowrail::TokenTag Lowrail::CollectionRender]
state = runtimes.to_h do |name|
  runtime = Lowrail.loaded_constant(name)
  [name, {admission: runtime.admission, refusal: runtime.refusal}]
end
raise "production admission failed" if ENV["LOWRAIL"] == "1" &&
  state.values.any? { _1.fetch(:admission)&.fetch(:state) != "active" || _1.fetch(:refusal) }
puts "PRODUCTION_COHORT_FINAL #{JSON.generate(check.call.merge(runtime_state: state))}"
